name: fmp_ipo_calendar
description:
IPO calendar from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/ipo-calendar): company, expected date, exchange, price range and shares offered for upcoming and recent listings.
Returns {ipos}: FMP's list of IPO records.
Inputs (* required): from_date (YYYY-MM-DD), to_date (YYYY-MM-DD); both optional.
For private offerings use fmp_equity_offering or fmp_crowdfunding_rss; other calendars: fmp_earnings_calendar, fmp_dividend_calendar.
Example: {"from_date": "2025-09-01", "to_date": "2025-09-30"}
